facts.fact: StackAdapt's Platform Quality team spans 4 time zones and 3 countries, according to the company's own blog post.
facts.quote: Our team spans across 4 time zones and 3 countries, which means we get to work with people from across the globe.

facts.fact: StackAdapt says its Platform Quality team has built infrastructure and 24/7 support to execute same-day turnarounds for clients in sensitive industries such as political advertising.
facts.quote: Our team has built infrastructure and 24/7 support to execute same day turnarounds, because we know that speed makes a huge difference!

facts.fact: StackAdapt's Platform Quality team vets and reviews every campaign before it goes live and approves every domain on its sitelist, per the company's blog post.
facts.quote: Our team vets and reviews every campaign before it goes live. They also approve every domain on our sitelist, enabling StackAdapt to have a proactive approach to brand safety.

facts.fact: The StackAdapt blog post 'Life in Adtech: Ensuring every ad is set up for success' was published on 27 October 2022.
